messages:
leah: Quick heads-up — we need to land a small security patch on release/1.8 before cutoff. Requesting a late-merge exception. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5423
alex: link and short summary?
leah: Fix is a dependency pin for a CVE in our HTTP lib (urllib3) — bump to 1.26.15 and update packaging metadata. No API changes, tests added + unit CI is green. Diff is tiny.
leah: git commands I used to reproduce locally:
```bash
git checkout release/1.8
git pull origin release/1.8
git fetch origin pull/5423/head:pr-5423
git cherry-pick pr-5423
``` 
noah: Reminder: code freeze for 1.8 goes into effect at 2026-03-12T18:00:00Z — late merges require a brief risk note, CI green, a rollback plan, and release manager signoff. Can you paste the risk + rollback steps here?
leah: Risk: very low. This is a transitive dep bump, no surface-area changes to our runtime. All unit/integration tests pass. We ran a quick smoke on staging and exercised streaming + batching endpoints.
leah: Rollback plan:
```bash
# if this causes regressions
git checkout release/1.8
git revert <merge-commit-hash>
git push origin release/1.8
# trigger deploy rollback via console (runbook section 4.2)
``` 
leah: CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/5423 — all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). Staging smoke completed by @sre_oncall :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: release-bot: Code freeze for release/1.8 is active starting 2026-03-12T18:00:00Z. Exceptions must include release manager approval and a rollover window. (automated message)
sre_oncall: did smoke on staging, exercised long-running stream + kv-cache hit case — looked fine. noah: can you take a look + approve/deny? we need to merge before the 20:00 UTC deploy window.
noah: I'll review now. Can you paste the exact changelog entry you want to include? we try to avoid ambiguous entries during freeze.
leah: Changelog line: "security: pin urllib3 to 1.26.15 to address CVE-2026-xxxx (low risk)." Short and explicit.
alex: I can do a quick code review in ~10m. if everything is small and CI stays green, :+1: from me.
noah: Thanks. Two quick asks before signoff: 1) add a one-sentence test note in the PR describing the staging smoke steps, and 2) ensure the release tag is created after merge (we'll annotate the tag with the exception reason).
leah: Added the test note and updated PR description. Tag plan noted.
noah: Ok — I've read the PR, smoke logs, and rollback steps. Given the low blast radius and passing checks, I approve this late merge. I will annotate the release tag with "exception: security-dep-pin approved by noah" once merged. Approved to merge into release/1.8. :thumbsup:
alex: review done, minor nits fixed, LGTM.
leah: merging now.
deploy-bot: release-bot: merge recorded — PR #5423 merged into release/1.8 by leah at 2026-03-12T19:12:58Z. Exception approved by noah.
noah: noted. I'll annotate tag and watch the 19:30 smoke window. ping me if anything odd shows up.
sre_oncall: will monitor staging and can hold rollback window open for 30m after deploy.
leah: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
